what_happened: The job changed plan code in crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs and added a 'plans' test. The verifier rejected it at the final verdict. One of 6 acceptance criteria was unmet: the new 'plans' test must fail when the criterion check is reverted to `plans(reading.hard_reason.is_some())` alone. One major finding was listed: behavior criterion 3's evidence must cite commands that ran (D43), and none did. No blocker is named and no checks are listed as failed. The fix is not reported as wrong. The criterion could not be shown because no without-fix run was recorded.
cause: Athena's checks run once, on the final tree. No step reverts a change on a scratch copy and records the result, and the verifier sees only the diff, the criteria and those recorded checks. The reading still writes 'fails without the fix' criteria whose evidence exists only if such a revert run happens. Nothing cross-checks a criterion's evidence source against what the verifier can observe. This is the fourth job in this pattern, and each retry or re-ask copies the criterion instead of giving it an evidence path. The earlier rejections did not turn into a check.
prevention: Build a revert-run capability into Athena's checks. For any criterion tagged 'fails without the fix', Athena itself reverts the named production change on a scratch copy of the final tree. It runs the named test there and records the command, the exit status and the failing output under 'Checks Athena ran'. The verifier then sees real evidence. Also add an admission-time check on the reading. Every criterion must name an evidence source the verifier receives (a recorded check, the diff, or a file in the tree). A 'fails without the fix' criterion is refused, or rewritten to a recorded revert check, until the capability exists.
proposed_request: Make Athena record a without-fix run for behavior criteria. When a job's accepted reading has a criterion saying a named test fails without the fix, Athena must do the following after the normal checks pass. It reverts the named production change on a scratch copy of the final tree, runs the named test command there, and records the command, exit status and failing output in the checks the verifier receives, under 'Checks Athena ran'. The scratch copy must never touch the job's real tree or branch. If the revert cannot be applied or the test does not fail, record that as a failed check with the reason. Also refuse a reading at acceptance if a criterion depends on evidence the verifier cannot see, and say which criterion and why. Acceptance: (1) a test where the revert makes the test fail shows the recorded failing run in the verifier input; (2) a test where the test still passes without the fix is recorded as a failed check; (3) the job's real tree is unchanged after the run; (4) a reading with a 'fails without the fix' criterion that Athena cannot revert is refused with a clear reason. Then re-ask job 20261104-081830-js1p (the 'plans' test for the criterion check in crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs) so the same criterion can be proved.
